message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) for this case. Facts: Involved buying and illegally providing other people's credit card information. This is a specific offense under Chinese criminal law: "收买、非法提供他人信用卡信息罪" (Crime of buying and illegally providing others' credit card information). The prosecution says that. So the correct charge is that. Possibly also "信用卡诈骗罪"? But they are not using cards to fraud, they are buying and providing info. The crime is defined in Article 182-3? Actually Chinese law: Article 182-3 of Criminal Law (since amendment) defines "非法获取、出售或者提供信用卡信息罪" (illegal acquisition, sale or provision of credit card information). Also "收买、非法提供他人信用卡信息罪" is the same. So the correct label: 收买、非法提供他人信用卡信息罪.

Check if any other crimes: They also used the cards to commit fraud (the 1,689,530 yuan fraud). But the main charge is buying and providing credit card info. The prosecution may also charge "诈骗罪" for the fraud. However the description says "公诉机关认为，被告人王1某伙同被告人陈2某、于某收买、非法提供他人信用卡信息，数额巨大，应以收买、非法提供他人信用卡信息罪追究其刑事责任。" So they only propose that charge. So answer: [罪名]收买、非法提供他人信用卡信息罪<eoa>
